free_text: The patient is a 62-year-old male with an elevated PSA of 6.1 and a confirmed Gleason 3+4 (ISUP Grade Group 2) adenocarcinoma in the transition zone, apex right, identified by PI-RADS 4 MRI. He has comorbidities including Type 2 diabetes and COPD. The management assessment is pending clinical review to determine individual treatment benefit and patient preferences, balancing potential cancer control against treatment side effects.
